method: Reconcile persisted H and decision/fill ledgers against exact BT-01 product+maturity B; do not rerun strategies.

assumptions.decisionAndFillLedgers: Never rewritten; replay rows are checked where present and stored run summaries are consumed where per-arm rows are absent.
